placements.why: The content describes how the pipeline is designed to respond autonomously when an explicit id is absent — an architectural concern about system behavior under missing inputs.
placements.title: From manual specification to autonomous system behavior
placements.frame: What does the system do on its own when inputs are incomplete?

placements.title: Pipeline fills its own identification gap
placements.frame: How does the pipeline produce identification when none is supplied, and what fallback paths does it use?
placements.why: src-1 records the triggering condition — a submission without an explicit id — and src-2 prescribes the pipeline's required response: generate a slug via the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback, then commit the file. Together they name a subject future envelopes will keep feeding: the pipeline's autonomous identification generation when none is provided.
